provenance.source: PR #4659 fix(bearer-auth): make auth-scheme case-insensitive, squash-merged 2026-02-06
provenance.note: the configured auth scheme is spliced into a regular expression instead of being compared as a literal, so the scheme is matched by pattern: a prefix of X.Y accepts the header scheme XZY, a prefix of X.Auth+v2 rejects its own literal scheme, and a prefix holding an unmatched bracket throws while the middleware is built; the base builds the same pattern in the same way, and this PR only added the case-insensitive flag to it, so the defect is rewritten rather than introduced here (fix PR #4750)

bugs.note: the option and the token grammar are concatenated into one RegExp source, so every metacharacter in the configured scheme is live; the fix compares the header prefix as a string and tests the token with its own anchored pattern
